newsitem.title: USA: Jostens CFO joining Carlson unit.
newsitem.headline: Jostens CFO joining Carlson unit.

text.p: Jostens Inc said Friday that Trudy Rautio, senior vice president and chief financial officer, will resign effective July 1 to become executive vice president and CFO of Carlson Hospitality Worldwide.
Carlson Hospitality is a $4.6 billion unit of Carlson Cos Inc.
Jostens said a search for a successor to Rautio was under way.
Jostens said Jack Thornton, senior vice president-imaging, also resigned effective July 1 to pursue other interests.

Carlson Hospitality, the parent of more than 1,100 hotels, resorts, restaurants and cruise ships operating around the world, said in a statment that Rautio will be responsible for developing and implementing financial strategies for expansion of the Carlson Hospitality organization, which it said is projected to grow to over 2,000 locations in the year 2000.

Carlson Hospitality includes Regent International Hotels and Resorts, Radisson Hotels Worldwide, Radisson Seven Seas Cruises, Country Inns & Suites by Carlson, T.G.I. Friday's restaurants, Italianni's restaurants, Friday's Front Row Sports Grills, Friday's American Bars and Country Kitchen restaurants.
Jostens's products include yearbooks, class rings, graduation products, school photography and business service and achievement awards.
